commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Roger Marti (Cadiz) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 2:1 – the corner kicks stats.
88' A cross by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
84' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Vedat Muriqi will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
84' That's the end of the game for Pablo Maffeo, who is replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
81' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' Substitution. Chris Ramos will be replaced by Roger Marti (Cadiz).

76' The attendance is 18174.

76' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
75' Cadiz CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
73' Fali (Cadiz) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
72' The ball is cleared after Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Costa trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
70' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
67' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.
65' Juanmi will be replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).

63' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Conan Ledesma makes a comfortable save.
62' Ooh that was close! Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
59' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) puts the ball into his own net.
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nemanja Radonjic as he is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
56' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
53' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
52' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
49' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Conan Ledesma intercepts the ball.
47' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' Half-time substitution. Aiham Ousou (Cadiz) will not participate anymore and Sergio Guardiola is coming on.

46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Victor Chust (Cadiz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

45+4' A big opportunity is wasted by Chris Ramos (Cadiz), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Predrag Rajkovic pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
45+4' Victor Chust (Cadiz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
45+2' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
45+2' Juanmi (Cadiz) commits a foul and Isidro Diaz de Mera immediately signals a free kick.

41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Chris Ramos (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
38' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
36' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Cadiz CF keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
32' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
32' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Juanmi (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
28' The referee blows for a cooling break.
25' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
24' Dangerous play by Matija Nastasic (Mallorca). Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The Cadiz CF players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' The foul by Robert Navarro (Cadiz) was seen by Isidro Diaz de Mera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
19' A rebound falls to Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
18' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Predrag Rajkovic easily catches the ball.
16' Victor Chust (Cadiz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
14' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Predrag Rajkovic comes off his line to gather the ball.

12' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) bravely launches himself at a cross from Martin Valjent and gives Conan Ledesma no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
11' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. Victor Chust (Cadiz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' Juanmi (Cadiz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) is able to continue to play.
7' The game is interrupted now, Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Victor Chust (Cadiz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Cadiz CF as they win a corner.
3' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
